description: HELD-OUT extraction cases. Written after the extraction prompt was frozen, from bank SMS templates that do not appear in the dev set. No failure in this file has ever been used to change a prompt, and none may be.
coverage: Thirteen banks absent from dev entirely (Bank of Baroda, PNB, Canara, Union Bank, IndusInd, Yes Bank, IDFC FIRST, Federal Bank, RBL, AU Small Finance, Bank of India, Indian Bank, Central Bank) plus the five dev banks in templates they also send but which dev does not cover - HDFC's 'Sent Rs.X From ... To ...' UPI wording, SBI's 'Dear UPI user A/C X1234 debited by 240.0' wording, ICICI's ATM withdrawal and Axis's 'Thank you for using Debit Card' wording. Date formats include two not in dev: DD-MM-YYYY and DD/MM/YYYY with a four-digit year.
fields: amount, merchant, transactionType, transactionDate, accountLast4 are scored independently. 'merchant' is a list of acceptable spellings, compared case- and punctuation-insensitively; an empty string in that list means 'no merchant is the right answer', for the banks whose templates genuinely do not name one. expected=null means the message is not a transaction.

cases.source: HDFC Bank UPI debit alert template, the newer 'Sent Rs.X From HDFC Bank A/C *nnnn To MERCHANT On DD/MM/YY Ref' wording. Not represented in dev, which uses the older 'debited from A/c XX to VPA' form.
cases.sms: Sent Rs.150.00 From HDFC Bank A/C *1234 To ZEPTO On 02/10/26 Ref 526123456789 Not You? Call 18002586161/SMS BLOCK UPI to 7308080808
